title: Hatsune Miku — Where Could The Big Shell Be?〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: Where Could The Big Shell Be?（3★）

rows.Line: Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hi Emu♪>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hi, Miku!
Are you here to see me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yeah, but I want to see you in SEKAI!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Are you free right now?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I don't have school today, so I'll head right over!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You will?! Yay!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Then it's off to SEKAI☆>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's go!
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Welcome back, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And thanks for coming on such short notice, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hi, Len! Hi, Rin!
Oh...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The stage curtains are up!
Are you guys about to do a show?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Correct! Good eye, Emu♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We got some ideas when we went to the beach with you and decided to make a show out of it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's our thanks to you for taking us to the beach and letting us see the ocean!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: For me?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah☆
For now, Emu, please sit wherever you like♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then let's start the show! Welcome to the special matinee featuring Miku, Rin and Len☆

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This beach is a place where many children come to play. The sea and sky are as blue as ever, and there isn't a cloud in the sky.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But a certain someone is feeling a little blue themselves.

rows.Speaker: Tinny
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Why me? Did I do something bad?

rows.Speaker: Miss Fish
rows.Line: Huh? Well if it isn't Tinny the tin toy!

rows.Speaker: Tinny
rows.Line: Oh... Miss Fish?

rows.Speaker: Miss Fish
rows.Line: Yes, it's me! Why the long face? And where's the boy that you're always with...?

rows.Speaker: Tinny
rows.Line:
He threw me away...
His friends said that I was old and boring, so...

rows.Speaker: Miss Fish
rows.Line:
No, that's awful...!
You two seemed so close...

rows.Speaker: Miss Fish
rows.Line:
Please, Tinny, try to cheer up!
Come with me. We can have some fun together!

rows.Speaker: Miss Fish
rows.Line: I'm sure if you see how sparkly it is in the ocean, you'll feel much better!

rows.Speaker: Tinny
rows.Line:
Thank you, Miss Fish.
But...

rows.Speaker: Tinny
rows.Line: The water in the ocean is really salty, right? It'll make my body rust.

rows.Speaker: Tinny
rows.Line: And I'm heavier than I look, so I'll probably just end up sinking to the bottom...

rows.Speaker: Miss Fish
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Tinny
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I appreciate what you're trying to do for me.

rows.Speaker: Tinny
rows.Line: But I'm a tin toy. My arm, leg and neck joints are all as hard as rocks. That was probably part of the reason why he...

rows.Speaker: Miss Fish
rows.Line: No, don't say that...!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Huh? I thought I heard someone crying...

rows.Speaker: Miss Fish
rows.Line:
Oh no! It's a human girl!
Quick, we need to hide!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Oh... Were you the one that was crying, Mr. Tin Toy?

rows.Speaker: Tinny
rows.Line: Yes. I was thrown away and abandoned here.

rows.Speaker: Tinny
rows.Line: Miss Fish here tried to cheer me up by inviting me to see the ocean, but I can't go in so...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Wait, I know! I have a great idea♪

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Okay, first... I need to empty this bag I used to put shells in!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Mr. Tin Toy, just bear with me!

rows.Speaker: Tinny
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, hold on! What are you going to do with me?!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I'm placing you inside this bag! I just have to close it up and...! There, now you can go in the ocean!

rows.Speaker: Tinny
rows.Line: I... I can?!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: You'll be fine! See...?

rows.Speaker: Tinny
rows.Line:
Oh... Y-You're right.
This bag's keeping me dry!

rows.Speaker: Miss Fish
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Miss Fish
rows.Line: That's amazing! Now I can show you around!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Oh, you must be Miss Fish!
Nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Miss Fish
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you too♪
And thank you for doing this! Tinny can see how beautiful the ocean is now!

rows.Speaker: Miss Fish
rows.Line: And since you're here, would you like to join us?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I can come too? Yay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And so, the three of them were able to have a wonderful time in the ocean.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Oh, I need to go home soon...

rows.Speaker: Tinny
rows.Line:
Thank you so much.
I wouldn't have been able to have so much fun without you.

rows.Speaker: Miss Fish
rows.Line: Me too! How about we do this again tomorrow♪

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
I really want to...
But I'm not sure I can. I don't live around here and have to go back home today.

rows.Speaker: Miss Fish
rows.Line: I see... I wish we could play more.

rows.Speaker: Tinny
rows.Line: Yeah, me too...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Wanna come to my house? I really don't want to say goodbye yet either so...

rows.Speaker: Tinny & Miss Fish
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Miss Fish
rows.Line: You'll take us with you?! Thank you so much! I've always wanted to see what a city full of people looks like!

rows.Speaker: Tinny
rows.Line: I'd really like that too. It's just so much better knowing that someone wants to play with me.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Okay, then let's go!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: This time, you get to go in my bag, Miss Fish!

rows.Speaker: Miss Fish
rows.Line: Okay! Make sure to fill it with plenty of seawater too♪

rows.Speaker: Tinny
rows.Line: Wait, what about all the shells you found? Are you just gonna leave them here...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's okay!
I'd rather have you guys around!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And so, Tinny, Miss Fish and the girl lived happily ever after.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The end.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Miku, Rin, Len!
That was really really super amazing!
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you liked it♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Especially considering how hard we worked on it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We really did, huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, you should show this play to the plushies and Tsukasa and everyone else!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's such a cute story too! It'd be terrible if I'm the only that ends up getting to see it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You think so? Hehe. Then let's give it a shot.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm all for that♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Let's do it♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Great☆ Then we can start inviting everyone right away♪

rows.Speaker: Emu, Rin & Len
rows.Line: Yeah!
